harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd installed), loaded application keys under /app, then simulated permanent loss of node3's member (stopped service, wiped data, removed member from cluster while preserving 2-node quorum), and replaced it with a fresh member on the same node3 via `member add` + `--initial-cluster-state existing`. The new node3 member synced and served all original keys, restoring a healthy 3-member cluster. Completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-verify protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3 via direct GitHub release download
Configured /etc/hosts and firewalld (etcd-client/etcd-server services) on all nodes
Created systemd units and bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (node1, node2, node3)
Wrote application keys /app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag_x, /app/service/orders/replicas
Captured healthy baseline: member list, endpoint health, endpoint status, key contents
Simulated permanent loss of node3 member: stopped/disabled etcd, wiped /var/lib/etcd data
Confirmed 2-of-3 quorum preserved and node3 endpoint unreachable while node1/node2 stayed healthy
Removed dead member (d05e13460d30257e) via etcdctl member remove
Added replacement member (etcdctl member add node3) and reconfigured node3 systemd unit with --initial-cluster-state existing
Started new node3 member; verified it joined, synced, and served all original application keys
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd active status for all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), each acknowledged before disconnect
Polled each node until reachable again and confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart etcd health, member list, endpoint status, and full key recovery after each node restart

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster healthy baseline with application keys before disruption
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all 'started'; endpoint health all healthy; /app keys written and read back on node2

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost, data unrecoverable, quorum preserved during disruption
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped/disabled and /var/lib/etcd wiped; subsequent health check shows node3 endpoint connection refused/unhealthy while node1 and node2 remain healthy (2-of-3 quorum intact)

evidence.requirement: dead member removed and replacement member added on same node3, cluster restored to 3 healthy members with original keys intact
evidence.summary: member remove of dead node3 ID, member add of new node3 peer, etcd started successfully on node3; final member list/endpoint status shows 3 started members at matching raft applied index 23, all endpoints healthy, and node3 directly serving all three /app keys

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 45c22b1f captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged (ack) before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 61cc8462 (changed); etcd cluster health, member list, and /app keys verified recovered, etcd service confirmed active

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id bccb87ac captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id f07e3b67 (changed); cluster health, member list, and /app keys verified recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 06339ff3 captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id a0f970d2 (changed); final cluster-wide member list, endpoint status (all raft applied index 37), and /app key contents confirm full recovery of the replaced node3 member and the whole cluster
